nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the name of the family piggy bank; written in the constructor.
Public mapping(address => uint) tracking the credited balance of each saver; written by constructor, einzahlen and abbuchen.
Public uint initialized with address(this).balance representing the total Ether held by all savers.
Payable constructor(string _name, address _sparer): stores the name, reads msg.value into startGuthaben and credits the beneficiary or msg.sender.
Public payable function that credits msg.value as the balance of msg.sender.
Public function that checks the caller balance, subtracts _betrag and transfers the Ether to msg.sender.
Public view getter returning the balance of the supplied address.
Public pure function returning the sum of two unsigned integers.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key, transfer recipient and beneficiary fallback.
msg.sender.transfer(_betrag) external Ether transfer performed before the function returns; potential reentrancy/interaction point with a caller-controlled address.
guthaben[msg.sender] = guthaben[msg.sender] - _betrag unchecked subtraction (no SafeMath) in Solidity 0.4.24.
_menge1 + _menge2 unchecked addition in Solidity 0.4.24 that can silently overflow.
Constructor string parameter _name assigned to spardosenName.
Constructor address parameter _sparer used as the initial beneficiary.
Parameter _betrag of abbuchen used to check, subtract and transfer the requested amount.
Parameter _sparer of guthabenAnzeigen used as mapping lookup key.
First addend of the pure addieren function.
Second addend of the pure addieren function.
Local uint startGuthaben in the constructor holding msg.value before it is credited.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _name flows into the constructor body where it is assigned to spardosenName.
Constructor parameter _sparer flows into the constructor body and is used as the beneficiary mapping key.
Local startGuthaben (msg.value) flows into the constructor as the credited amount.
msg.sender is used in the constructor fallback to credit the caller when _sparer is the zero address.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key in einzahlen to store msg.value.
msg.sender is used in abbuchen to read, update and credit the caller balance.
Parameter _betrag flows into abbuchen and controls the withdrawal amount.
Parameter _sparer flows into guthabenAnzeigen as the mapping lookup key.
Parameter _menge1 flows into addieren as the first operand.
Parameter _menge2 flows into addieren as the second operand.
Caller-supplied _betrag is the value sent through the external msg.sender.transfer call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer, giving the caller control at the interaction point.
Parameter _betrag is the subtrahend in guthaben[msg.sender] - _betrag.
Parameter _menge1 is an operand of the unchecked addition.
Parameter _menge2 is an operand of the unchecked addition.
Constructor writes the state variable spardosenName.
Constructor updates the guthaben mapping for the beneficiary or the caller.
einzahlen updates the guthaben mapping with msg.value.
abbuchen reads and decreases the guthaben mapping entry before paying out.
guthabenAnzeigen reads the guthaben mapping to return the balance.
abbuchen always executes the msg.sender.transfer payout after the balance update, exposing an external interaction.
abbuchen executes the unchecked balance subtraction guarded only by require.
addieren executes the unchecked integer addition and returns the result.
The low-level transfer to the caller-controlled msg.sender can transfer control back into abbuchen, enabling a reentrancy attempt.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _name only exists to initialize the constructor scope and can be folded into the constructor function node.
Constructor parameter _sparer only exists to initialize the constructor scope and can be folded into the constructor function node.
Local startGuthaben is a temporary constructor value and can be merged into the constructor function node.
Parameter _betrag belongs solely to abbuchen and should be absorbed into the abbuchen function node.
Parameter _sparer belongs solely to guthabenAnzeigen and should be absorbed into the guthabenAnzeigen function node.
Parameter _menge1 belongs solely to addieren and should be absorbed into the addieren function node.
Parameter _menge2 belongs solely to addieren and should be absorbed into the addieren function node.
